entries.tuning_knob: Tune Pheromosa from +3 to +2 first, then Lopunny from +3 to +2; preserve the After You-Wishiwashi lead and no-Mega identity.

corpus_search.selection: Three complete reproducible donors support Lopunny, Wishiwashi, and Accelgor roles; one verified regional-winning roster supports Pheromosa's tournament legitimacy. The After You relay and exact White Herb set are transparently hand-authored for Dylan.

author_self_check.strongest_part: A Running Triathlete makes one of the game's slowest threatening forms look like the sprinter, then passes the race to two distinct glass-cannon reserves without another field mode or Mega.
author_self_check.weakest_link: Trick Room, priority, Water immunity, Wide Guard plus Hydro Pump scouting, and shared Flying, Psychic, and Fairy pressure are broad answers. Those seams are intentional; Pheromosa level is the first tuning knob.

identity.memory_hook: Mythical Choice Band Zeraora opens a four-leg sprint, followed by a Sash Destiny Bond trade, special Encore setup, or physical priority setup chosen by native matchup logic.

entries.primary_player_question: Can the player answer Choice-locked pivoting, a Sash trade, special setup plus Encore, and physical priority setup without one Ground or Water answer solving the entire sprint?
entries.tempo: Four changing fast singles legs—lock and pivot, Sash trade, special setup, physical priority—without a persistent field or custom AI subsystem.
pressure_sources: level-42 Choice Band Volt Absorb Zeraora
Wild Charge recoil, Close Combat, Knock Off, and Volt Switch
level-41 Focus Sash Cursed Body Froslass
Ice Beam, Shadow Ball, Will-O-Wisp, and Destiny Bond
Flamethrower, Sludge Bomb, Nasty Plot, and Encore
level-43 Expert Belt Tough Claws Dusk Lycanroc
Accelerock, Stone Edge, Close Combat, and Swords Dance
entries.intentional_opening: Zeraora is the only fixed slot. Choice Band makes its first attack or pivot readable after revelation, while Wild Charge recoil and Ground immunity create immediate counterplay. Every later replacement remains native matchup-ranked.
entries.intentional_weakness: All four are offense-first with no recovery or defensive field. Zeraora is choice-locked and takes recoil; Froslass depends on Sash and loses to priority or chip; Froslass and Salazzle are physically frail; Lycanroc is vulnerable before setup; three members expose Ground pressure and sturdy Water balance compresses the finish.
entries.first_loss_lesson: Raw Speed was not one puzzle. Read Zeraora's lock, preserve a Sash or Destiny Bond answer, deny the setup reserve that actually enters, and keep priority or Trick Room for Lycanroc rather than trying to outspeed all four.

entries.difficulty_rationale: Four optimized legal levels 41-43, full distinct items, a mythical Band opener, Sash Destiny Bond, exact published Encore setup, and Tough Claws priority setup make a serious adaptation-heavy route single. No healing, broad Ground and Water pressure, Choice exploitation, Sash chip, setup denial, and Trick Room keep it below the adjacent doubles and bosses.
entries.tuning_knob: Tune Dusk Lycanroc from +3 to +2 first, then Zeraora from +2 to +1; preserve the four-leg identity and mythical opener.

corpus_search.selection: Five complete donors support the four exact roles and one verified event winner supports Salazzle's legitimacy. The mixed four-leg sprint is transparently hand-authored, and unavailable local Plasma Fists is explicitly rejected for legal Wild Charge.

author_self_check.strongest_part: Four fast Pokémon ask four different questions without another subsystem, and an ordinary route trainer receives a memorable mythical opener in the rare-everywhere spirit of the game.
author_self_check.weakest_link: Sturdy Ground and Water balance compresses the roster after identifying Zeraora's lock. That broad answer is intentional; Dusk Lycanroc level is the first tuning knob.
